hardware.notes: WSL2 under Hyper-V: synthetic topology of 10 cores x 2 threads; the hybrid P/E-core layout of the i7-12700H is hidden from the guest (6a findings); STREAM-like triad peaks near 19.6 GB/s at 4 ranks (6a).

settings.spmv_traffic_model: bytes per SpMV = sum over ranks of nnz*(8+4) + (rows+1)*4 + rows*8 (x) + rows*8 (y); approximate lower bound, x assumed read once; time = max-over-ranks spmv_local + max-over-ranks spmv_ghost
settings.derived_basis: median over repetitions; solve time is the max over ranks
